name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 4 visits over 20 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 20 hours starting 2025-08-22, at wavelengths from 1.66 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
